identity_model_note: Polity/faction = a political or organized structure, NOT a people. Members and sub-cells may span species and allegiances.
peoplehood_note: A syndicate of corporate military contractors, not a people — multispecies and allegiance-fluid. Leadership: CEO/Military Commander Vailen Rix; Intelligence Chief Eriana Vos.

naming_exemption.reason: Faction name "PMC Syndicate" preserved from canonical GUMAS_Factions.json (engine faction set).

promotion_to_canon.rule: owner standing directive: discovered detail that does not conflict with canon IS canon
promotion_to_canon.process: aurora-canon-reconciler: name/alias collision scan + structural reference check + ReconciliationAdvisor scoring

known_operations.enclave_d19: PMC Syndicate Enclave D-19 operates a station and had quietly entered a covert contract with Union black ops to mine quantum-cortex components.
known_operations.significance: A named sub-unit, and a documented covert relationship running in the other direction from the usual framing: the Union is the client, not the adversary. Any scene treating the Syndicate as purely hostile to the Union has to account for this contract.

legal_exposure.memory_sovereignty_conflict: A PMC syndicate is used as the worked example of competing memory-sovereignty claims: where a Vindex Core AI claims territory by memory sovereignty and the syndicate presents an alternate reading of the same memory, both claims are simultaneously valid.
legal_exposure.standing: Raised as a design risk of gridlock or paradox rather than as an adjudicated in-world event. Recorded as an exposure the polity has, not as a case it has fought.
